name: WordPress websites
summary: Clean, fast WordPress sites your team can edit, without the plugin bloat.
answer: A WordPress website is a site built on the world's most widely used content management system, which makes it easy for your team to edit pages and publish posts. HTH builds lean WordPress sites with a custom theme or a block-based build, minimal plugins, fast hosting and forms connected to your CRM. It's for businesses that want full control over their content without sacrificing speed.
whoFor: Teams that publish content often and want to do it themselves
Businesses with an existing WordPress site that's slow or broken
Companies that need a familiar, widely supported platform

problem.heading: WordPress got slow, fragile and hard to update.
problem.body: Years of plugins, a heavy page builder and an old theme mean every update risks breaking something. The site is slow on mobile and nobody wants to touch it.

deliverables.title: Theme build
deliverables.detail: A lightweight custom or block theme, without bloated page builders.

deliverables.title: Editing setup
deliverables.detail: Reusable blocks and patterns so your team can build pages without breaking the design.

deliverables.title: Performance
deliverables.detail: Caching, image optimisation and good hosting to keep Core Web Vitals green.

deliverables.title: Security and backups
deliverables.detail: Updates, hardening and automatic backups configured from day one.

deliverables.title: CRM-connected forms
deliverables.detail: Forms and bookings that send leads straight into your CRM.

process.title: Plan
process.detail: Pages, content types and what your team needs to edit.

process.title: Build
process.detail: Theme, blocks and content on a staging site.

process.title: Launch and train
process.detail: Go-live, redirects, and a recorded editing walkthrough for your team.

faqs.question: Do you use Elementor or Divi?
faqs.answer: We prefer native blocks for speed and long-term stability, but can work in an existing Elementor site if a rebuild isn't practical.

faqs.question: Can you speed up our current WordPress site?
faqs.answer: Often, yes. We start with a performance audit and fix the biggest issues: hosting, images, plugins and caching.

faqs.question: Do you offer maintenance?
faqs.answer: Yes, a monthly plan covering updates, backups, uptime monitoring and small changes.
